entry.title: A review round is a unit of time
entry.summary: Wrote up two weeks of merged pull requests with one human reviewer. Median merge time fell from 17.5 to 8.7 hours while rounds per PR stayed near three: the round got cheaper, not rarer. Five diagrams.

entry.title: Fable Low Power Mode
entry.summary: Published the quota-aware skill I use to keep frontier-model time focused on judgment. For the same workflows, my allowance moved from roughly two days to at least five.

entry.title: Akar, a General Formation run
entry.summary: A one-line smoothie-business prompt became a grounded product wedge, identity, social assets, and a responsive site. It is a system output—not a claim that the physical business launched.
